mixdays.label: Mixed days: each day either 10 or 1,000

mixweeks.label: Mixed weeks: a quiet week (10/day), a busy week (1,000/day)

mixmonths.label: Mixed months: a dead month (0-2/day), then a busy month (500/day)

fadetozero.label: Starts at 300/day, fades to nothing by month 6

growth.label: Grows 10 -> 1,000 a day over the year

drought:200.label: 200 a day, 2 empty weeks every 2 months
